title: events/types/improvement.promoted
description: Payload for event_type 'improvement.promoted' (native type, feature 009; FR-803): a candidate pack passed metrics validation and every audit gate, and was promoted at an episode boundary. Scored-episode immutability is preserved — promotion never lands mid-episode.

pack_hash.description: Canonical-JSON hash of the promoted pack — release identity.

episode_boundary.description: Must be true; mid-episode promotion is a contract violation.

metrics.description: The metric values that justified promotion (candidate vs incumbent deltas).

source_cycle.description: selfcheck cycle that produced the candidate.
